summary:
Generated at 2026-11-09T12:36:52Z as a pre-market view, so the US equity and 22 sector rows are the settled 2026-11-06 close, the Asian block is the 2026-11-09 session and China A-shares are also the 2026-11-09 close. Total risk 70.52 stays in high_risk with the regime at risk_off for a 3rd consecutive session, up 1.62 from 68.90 on 2026-11-06. That 1.62 is not deterioration: cross-asset rose from 50.00 to 62.50 for 1.875 points as the gold leg flipped from down 0.9603 to up 1.0062, which is a live 2026-11-09 quote, while macro took 0.294 points back purely because the rate print rolled from 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-05, with the 10-year down from 4.90 to 4.84 and the 2-year from 4.58 to 4.46. The published trend_1d of down 0.03 is the gap between two generations inside the same run, not a day-over-day move, and 1.62 is the figure used here.

The overnight tape keeps repairing but the leadership has rotated. The 2026-11-06 US session was a broad AI-hardware rally: 19 of 22 rows rose for a mean of 3.0368, led by quantum computing at 13.9454, semiconductor equipment at 7.0255 and autonomous driving at 5.893, with AMD up 11.0386, MU up 5.1204 and NVDA up 2.7753, and the S&P 500 up 0.3124 against 0.9927 for the Russell 2000. Asia took over on 2026-11-09, with Taiwan's 2317.TW up 6.4588, Japan's 6861.T up 2.6237, the two Korean memory names up 0.3534 and 0.6359, and the Stoxx Europe 600 up 1. China went the other way: 4 of 11 names rose for a mean of down 0.4856, turnover stayed below 1.5 trillion yuan and the indices opened higher then faded. The real variable is Nvidia, where the board has opened an independent investigation into Huang's relationship with an alleged Chinese spy and the stock is down 5 premarket while S&P futures are up 0.7, the two pointing opposite ways.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation rose from 0.50 to 0.625 as the triggered legs went from 4 to 5, contributing 1.875 points, which is the entire source of this run's increase. The only leg that flipped is gold, from down 0.9603 to up 1.0062, quoted at 4115.90 as a live 2026-11-09 tick rather than a settled price. The other 4 triggered legs are dollar strength at 121.6656, real-rate pressure at 2.60, bitcoin down 1.81108 over 24 hours and small caps 3.8885 weaker on a 63-session basis; the first two are level indicators that a one-day rally cannot release.

Volatility at 72.62 is the second-largest weighted contributor at 7.41 points, but it rests on the 2026-11-05 VIX close of 28.18 at the 92.62 percentile, while the 2026-11-06 print has not landed. Realized volatility over 20 days is only 19.9407, which does not square with a 28.18 implied level. A 2026-11-06 VIX print near 20 would therefore hand back roughly 4 points in one step with no equity move at all.

Liquidity and credit is unchanged at 78.10 on a weight of 20 and is the floor holding the total in high_risk. High-yield OAS at 3.48 sits in the 89.31 percentile, only 0.52 below the 4 trigger; investment grade is 0.93 and overnight reverse repo at 0.15 is close to zero. This is the one risk source that has not retreated with the equity rebound, and the most leveraged falsifier.

Equity structure is essentially flat at 71.67, up 0.20, but the structure itself is still broken: 0.2645 of the universe sits above its 200-day average, which is 41 of 155 names, and new highs of 0.0127 compare with new lows of 0.0828, or 2 against 13 of 157. On a 63-session basis semiconductors are 17.7477 weaker and small caps 3.8885 weaker, so the rebound has not repaired relative structure.

Macro fell from 73.98 to 72.51 and took 0.294 points out, but that is a print roll rather than a price move: the 10-year went from 4.90 to 4.84 at the 92.46 percentile, the 2-year from 4.58 to 4.46, the real rate from 2.64 to 2.60 at the 97.19 percentile, and the curve steepened from 0.32 to 0.38. The dollar index at 121.6656 still sits on the 2026-10-30 print.

supporting_signals.claim: risk_off is confirmed by two independent gates at once: VIX at 28.18 is above the 28 threshold and breadth at 0.2645 is below the 0.35 threshold. Even if the volatility dimension deflates once the 2026-11-06 print lands, the regime call does not change until breadth repairs above 0.35.

Nvidia's governance shock is the most concrete single-name risk into the open: the board has opened an independent investigation into Huang's relationship with an alleged Chinese spy, he admitted infidelity to staff, and the stock is down 5 premarket. It closed at 186.639999 on 2026-11-06, up 2.7753, and sits in the 4-name semis basket.

Crypto is the only clearly risk-off asset overnight: bitcoin at 74538 is down 1.81108 over 24 hours, ether at 2119.07 is down 5.31638, solana at 86.22 is down 3.73007 and bitcoin dominance has risen to 0.602375. That runs against the calm in equities and credit.

contradicting_signals.claim: Asia outside China is risk-on: the consumer electronics theme at 2.7686 is set only by its two Asian legs, 1810.HK and 2317.TW, robotics at 2.6236 equals Japan's 6861.T on its own, memory at 0.4946 rests only on the two Korean memory names, and the Stoxx Europe 600 is up 1. That weakens the global meaning of risk_off, since the pressure is concentrated in China and in rates.

This run's increase is not deterioration but two mechanical items: the gold leg flipping added 1.875 points and the rate print roll took 0.294 points away. Strip those out and the score is essentially unchanged from 2026-11-06, so high_risk is a level call rather than a fresh escalation.

The 2026-11-06 advance was broad rather than narrow: 19 of 22 rows rose for a mean of 3.0368 and small caps at 0.9927 beat the S&P at 0.3124. That cuts against the broken-structure read and leaves room for breadth at 0.2645 to repair.

what_changed_today: Total score rose from 68.90 on 2026-11-06 to 70.52, a gain of 1.62; the published trend_1d of down 0.03 is the gap between two generations inside the same run, not a day-over-day move.
Cross-asset rose from 50.00 to 62.50 for 1.875 points; the only leg that flipped was gold, from down 0.9603 to up 1.0062.

Macro fell from 73.98 to 72.51 for 0.294 points as the rate print rolled from 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-05, with the 10-year from 4.90 to 4.84, the 2-year from 4.58 to 4.46, the real rate from 2.64 to 2.60 and the curve from 0.32 to 0.38; there is no new price information.
Equity structure rose from 71.47 to 71.67 for 0.04 points: breadth from 0.271 to 0.2645, new lows from 0.0892 to 0.0828 and new highs from 0.0191 to 0.0127.

The China leg is current this time: all 11 A-share series end on 2026-11-09, with 4 up and 7 down for a mean of down 0.4856 and 300223.SZ the worst at 1.8726 lower; the previous two briefs had to use an older session and that gap is now filled.
3 of the 22 rows are 2026-11-09 Asia reads rather than US: memory 0.4946, consumer electronics 2.7686 and robotics 2.6236; the other 19 rows are the 2026-11-06 US close.
Print timing: rates, credit and VIX stop at 2026-11-05, the dollar at 2026-10-30 and reverse repo plus inflation expectations at 2026-11-06. The score contains no 2026-11-06 rate or volatility print.
watch_next: CPI at 2026-11-10 13:30Z and PPI at 2026-11-13 13:30Z are the next macro tests: the 10-year at 4.84 sits in the 92.46 percentile and the real rate at 2.60 in the 97.19 percentile, so a hot print pushes both higher.
Whether volatility gives back: 72.62 rests entirely on the 2026-11-05 VIX of 28.18, and a 2026-11-06 print near 20 would hand back roughly 4 points with no equity move.

Whether Nvidia's governance shock spreads: down 5 premarket after closing at 186.639999 on 2026-11-06. Semiconductors are already 17.7477 weaker on a 63-session basis, and contagion into AI hardware as a group would be harder to hedge than a single name.
Credit is the highest-leverage falsifier: high-yield OAS at 3.48 is 0.52 from the 4 threshold, and crossing it would lift the liquidity and credit dimension and the widening leg together.
China is the other direction: turnover below 1.5 trillion yuan on 2026-11-09 with 7 of 11 names down, and continued shrinking volume would push A-shares from bottoming into a fresh leg lower.

bull_case.title: Bull case: volatility mean-reverts and the score returns toward 58
points: A 2026-11-06 VIX print near 20 takes volatility from 72.62 to roughly 44 and removes more than 4 points from the total.
Breadth repairs from 0.2645 above 0.35 and both risk_off gates fail at once.
Credit holds, with high-yield OAS staying near 3.48 and no further widening.

base_case.title: Base case: a 65 to 75 range
points: The 3 level dimensions, credit at 78.10, volatility at 72.62 and macro at 72.51, pin the score inside high_risk.
US equities chop between the Nvidia story and AI earnings, with the 22-row mean swinging around 0.
China stays narrow and light, with 4 to 5 of 11 names up.

bear_case.title: Bear case: credit confirms and the score clears 75
points: High-yield OAS crosses the 4 threshold, liquidity and credit pushes up from 78.10 and the widening leg triggers at the same time.
The Nvidia story spreads into AI hardware and the semiconductor relative gap widens beyond 17.7477.
Breadth breaks below 0.2 and new lows rise from 0.0828, carrying the regime past risk_off into a worse band.
